title: Product measures, Fubini and convolution
summary: Fubini's theorem in R^n for nonnegative functions and for L^1 functions; product measures for general measure spaces and Fubini for the product measure; completion of product measures; convolution, Young's inequality, mollifiers and the density of smooth functions in L^p.

objectives.description: Objectives for this unit will be finalised when it is prepared; the source material is lectures 18–21 of the 18.125 notes.

preparation.description: Read lecture 18: Fubini's theorem in R^n for nonnegative functions.
Read lecture 19: Fubini for L^1 functions and the product measure for general measure spaces.
Read lecture 20: Fubini for product measures, completion of product measures, convolutions.
Read lecture 21: Young's inequality, mollifiers, density of smooth functions in L^p.
